data.title: 矢来美羽 · 书架间的停留
data.description: 休日的书店里，她从架上抽出一本书，翻到夹着书签的那一页。
data.action: holding an open book beside a bookshelf
data.promptProse: Browsing a quiet secondhand bookstore in the afternoon, Miu slides a novel from a tall wooden shelf, smiling gently as she opens to the first page. Warm sunlight streams through the front window, illuminating wooden shelves and stacks of books.
